not_a_research_failure: A future/later-semester revised PEP volume may have an authoritative designed sequence before a locality has started using it.
A diagnostic probe can be valid instructional questioning without having a dedicated prevalence study, provided it is labelled as a probe rather than research-established misconception.
Local rollout cannot be represented as one nationwide PEP state because China uses multiple approved textbook series and locality-specific adoption.
publication_policy: Show exact revised-PEP grade/semester/unit placement where the canonical sequence supports it.
Only show below-unit detail at the evidence level actually verified.
Do not call PEP the national textbook.
Do not imply all revised PEP volumes were adopted simultaneously.
Every misconception retains its canonical evidence class.
Diagnostic questions are probes, not validated assessments.
Common Core remains a US baseline unless a state overlay is selected.
